data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to convert web links into rich visual previews.
data.what_it_does: Scrapes metadata from URLs to render customizable preview cards with titles, descriptions, and images. It also provides a function to extract page metadata manually for custom UI implementations.
use_when: You want to display rich previews of URLs inside chat or feed apps.
You need customizable cards with image, title, and description generated from a link.
avoid_when: You need deep scraping of complex JavaScript-heavy web applications.
You are running on web and encounter CORS restrictions without using a proxy URL.
strengths: Provides both a ready-to-use widget and a scraping function for custom UIs.
Supports customizable styling, caching duration, and fallback error states.
Cross-platform support across mobile and desktop.
weaknesses: May require a proxy URL to resolve CORS issues when used on the web.
Relies on standard web meta tags, which may fail on sites without proper Open Graph tags.
data.minimal_example:
LinkPreviewGenerator(
    bodyMaxLines: 3,
    link: 'https://github.com/ghpranav/link_preview_generator',
    linkPreviewStyle: LinkPreviewStyle.large,
    showGraphic: true,
)
